findings.current:
> - A sky that lost its mama? What a strange saying.

“Why would the sky lose its mama? Are you insulting my mother, you bastard? Maybe I should just destroy you right now.”
findings.defect: The draft invents the sky as the one that lost its mother and changes Taekyung’s accusation of a crude mom joke into a direct insult against his own mother. It also softens the profanity.
findings.rationale: The Warlord mangles the proverb into a phrase about someone losing his mother, and Taekyung reacts by accusing him of 패드립, a crude joke or insult involving someone’s parents.
findings.replacement:
> - A man who lost his mama? What a strange saying.

“Why would he lose his mama? Making mom jokes now, you fucking bastard? Maybe I should just destroy you.”
findings.source:
- 마마 잃은 중천공? 별 희한한 말도 있군.

“마마를 왜 잃어. 패드립 치네 시벌놈이. 확 그냥 소멸시켜 버릴까 보다.”

>

>

findings.defect: This game notice lacks the required System heading, retains prohibited square brackets around UI terms, and places every complete notice in outer bold.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rules require each actual game-message window to be headed “System,” with no square-bracket framing or blanket bolding.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
>
> - Lv. 105 Skeleton Warlord has used a special Skill!
>
> - Special Skill, Summon the Dead, has been activated!
>
> - The sleeping dead answer the Commander's call!

findings.current: The Warlord asked in a voice that genuinely could not understand me.
findings.defect: The English ungrammatically makes the voice itself unable to understand him rather than conveying the Warlord’s genuine bewilderment.
findings.rationale: The Korean describes the incomprehension expressed in the Warlord’s voice.
findings.replacement: The Warlord asked again, sounding genuinely baffled.
findings.source: 워로드가 진심으로 이해가 안 된다는 목소리로 되물었다.

findings.current: If the winds of liberation ever swept through the Black Forest, the independent Skeletons would put him at the top of their purge list.
findings.defect: “Independent Skeletons” changes 독립군 from an organized independence movement into Skeletons that are merely autonomous, weakening the collaborator-and-liberation analogy.
findings.rationale: 독립군 specifically means independence fighters or an independence army, matching the surrounding 친인파 collaborator joke and the reference to liberation and purging.
findings.replacement: If the winds of liberation ever swept through the Black Forest, the Skeleton independence fighters would put him at the top of their purge list.
findings.source: 만약 검은 숲에 광복의 바람이 분다면 독립군 스켈레톤들이 숙청해야 할 대상 1순위다.

findings.current: “Commander of the undead army. Yes, yes. I’m going to get that tattooed on my ears.”
findings.defect: The invented tattoo image mistranslates 귀에 딱지 앉겠다, which means he has heard the repeated boast so often that his ears are figuratively developing calluses.
findings.rationale: The source uses a conventional idiom of irritated overfamiliarity, not an image of deliberately memorizing the title.
findings.replacement: “Commander of the undead army. Yeah, yeah. I’m getting calluses on my ears from hearing it.”
findings.source: “망자 군단의 사령관. 그래. 이제 귀에 딱지 앉겠다.”

summary: One meaningful historical-metaphor mistranslation, two localized voice/idiom issues, one altered wordplay exchange, and three System-panel formatting violations.
